description: Premium UI/UX overhaul of all screens - rebuild every screen with modern premium design: clean white backgrounds, proper card styling with subtle borders, orange-red accent CTAs, campaign cards with progress bars and platform icons, Nuvio-style profile page, clean Admin panel without glassmorphism, and add a Privacy Policy screen with real content.
steps: STEP 1 - Rebuild HomeScreen (Discover): Keep existing structure but ensure campaign cards have proper progress bars (colored green/amber/red based on fill %), platform icons row, bookmark icon, brand logo square, category badge. Remove any remnant glassmorphism. Ensure search bar and filter chips use clean white style with gray-100 backgrounds.

STEP 2 - Rebuild CampaignsScreen (Tasks): Clean white cards with subtle border for each campaign. Show brand name, title, payout, deadline, slots progress. Add Apply button per campaign with working CTA (orange-red). Campaign detail dialog with full info. Category filter chips at top.

STEP 3 - Rebuild WalletScreen: Replace all GlassSurface usages with clean Surface cards (white + subtle border). Balance card shows available, pending, total earned in clean white card. Transaction items use clean card style. Quick action buttons (Add Money, Withdraw) with clean rounded style.

STEP 4 - Rebuild ProfileScreen (Nuvio-style): Avatar section with edit icon overlay. Stats row (Money earned, Total campaigns, Engagement %). 'Connected accounts' dark button. Settings list items with icon + label + arrow/trailing text. Referrals badge. Logout at bottom in red.

STEP 5 - Rebuild AdminScreen with clean white UI (no glassmorphism): Remove FloatingGlassCard and GlassSurface from admin. Use clean white Surface cards with subtle gray border. Tabs for Overview/KYC/Transactions/Users. Stats cards with numbers. Real data from Supabase for pending KYC, deposits, withdrawals. Add methods to fetch admin data from Supabase.

STEP 6 - Rebuild NotificationsScreen: Clean white cards for each notification. Icon based on type (campaign, payment, system). Unread indicator (dot or bold text). Time ago format. Mark all as read button in top bar.
STEP 7 - Rebuild SettingsScreen: Clean white background. Settings items with icon + label + toggle/arrow. Theme toggle, notification toggles, app version. Sign out button.

STEP 8 - Rebuild AuthScreen (Login/Register): Clean modern design with white background. Logo/brand at top. Email/password fields with rounded borders. Orange-red 'Sign In'/'Sign Up' button. Tab toggle between Login and Register. Forgot password link.

STEP 9 - Add PrivacyPolicyScreen: Create new screen at ui/screens/settings/PrivacyPolicyScreen.kt with real privacy policy content for Rexo Marketplace (data collection, usage, sharing, user rights, contact info). Add navigation route in NavGraph.kt. Link from Settings and Profile.

STEP 10 - Admin auto-access for rexoagency.in@gmail.com: Ensure that in AuthViewModel.checkAdminRole() and UserRepository.isAdminEmail(), the email 'rexoagency.in@gmail.com' is recognized. Also ensure that when this email signs in, a users table row with role='admin' is created/updated if not exists.
acceptance_criteria: All screens use clean white backgrounds with subtle gray borders on cards
No GlassSurface or FloatingGlassCard with blur/glass effects anywhere in the app
Campaign cards show progress bars, platform icons, bookmark icons
Profile page matches Nuvio reference style (avatar, stats row, connected accounts, settings list)
Admin panel uses clean white cards without glassmorphism
Privacy policy screen exists with real content
Auth screen has modern clean design
verification: Run ./gradlew assembleDebug and confirm zero compilation errors
